title: Nana Wada Main Zainab
body:
Nana Wada Main Zainab Da Okhay Waqat Nibhay Saan Nal Bhira De
<<DIVIDER>>
Islam Di Baqa Laye Bhawain Pahar Howan Zulam Jafa De Nana
<<DIVIDER>>
Putran De Milan De Kitay Jadan Karbal Awain
Ghazi De Bazoo Chum Ke Pahlan Gal Lawain
Maiku Dooron An Bulawain
Pahray Daindi Ho San Baj Rida De Nana
<<DIVIDER>>
Teday Putra Di Nasal Rahway Gi Mahshar De Tori
Eyo Tarka Sanwaray Ghar Da Ujri Di Jori
Sadqa Tendi Pak Shabeeh Da
Day San Dowain Bachray Vich Sehra De Nana
<<DIVIDER>>
Vich Ban De Hassan De Chan Di Aa Vaikhay Shadi
Gandri Vich Ho Si Nana Qismat Kubra Di
Ho Si Ainj Da Rang Sehray Da
Vaikhay Athru Wasday An Qaza De Nana
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaindi Masnad Pak Hay Nana Ohday Pyo Da Seena
Mityan Te Ruldi Ho Si Masoom Sakeena
Ho San Kan Yateem De Zakhmi
Haye Zakham Jalay Cholay Di Bha De Nana
<<DIVIDER>>
Tatheer Di Ayat Di Main Tafseer Haan Nana
Main Pak Lisan Ullah Di Taseer Han Nana
Ro San Saray Pak Paiyyambar
Sun Ke Khutbay Sham Ich Oan Di Maa De Nana
<<DIVIDER>>
Ik Mor Te Zulam Di Had Da Ay Haal Howay Si
Mainday Sar Di Khulay Walan Da Rang Lal Howay Si
Ro Si Rat De Athro Abad
Anday Ho San Vain Amri Zahra De Nana
